profile.name: coder
profile.configYaml:
# profile heading
unknown_root: 'preserve-single-quotes'
approvals:
  mode: smart
  deny:
    - 'rm -rf *'
command_allowlist:
  - cargo test
plugins:
  unknown_child: preserve-me
  enabled:
    - reviewer
  disabled:
    - legacy
mcp_servers:
  docs:
    url: https://example.com/mcp
    enabled: true
    tools:
      include:
        - search
    headers:
      Authorization: must-not-import-yaml-header
      X-Token: ${HEADER_TOKEN}
  local:
    command: node
    args:
      - server.js
    env:
      DOCS_TOKEN: ${DOCS_TOKEN}
      LEAK: must-not-import-yaml-env
  old:
    command: old-server
    enabled: false
hooks:
  shell:
    enabled: true
    post_tool:
      command: check-write
  disabled:
    enabled: false
    post_tool:
      command: old-check
provider:
  api_key: must-not-import-provider-key

files.memories/USER.md:
# User memory
User prefers concise output.
files.skills/review/SKILL.md:
---
name: review
description: Review a change.
---
Review the diff.
files.skills/review/references/guide/SKILL.md:
---
name: review-guide
description: Nested review guidance.
---
Nested review guidance.

name: reviewer
version: 1.2.3
description: Review changes.
requires_env:
  - REVIEW_TOKEN
